'''Kolbrun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Acolyte]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was studying at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />
